product_from_film: RoboDock presents robotic charging and inspection for autonomous-vehicle depots.
explains_well: A labelled real demo follows a red car through parking, inspection, port detection, charging and departure.
unclear: The polished depot sequence and brief real demo do not show how failed checks or difficult charging cases are handled.
scenario: Charge and inspect a vehicle before returning it to service.
product_clear_basis: A robot arm approaches the charge port after the RoboDock depot introduction.

lessons.keep: Repeat the proposed workflow in a labelled real demonstration.
lessons.avoid: Avoid letting broad compatibility claims outrun the cases actually shown.
